units.source_text: 清晨，木匠们吵吵嚷嚷，正在修缮房子。

en.t: Early in the morning, the carpenters were noisily repairing the house.

units.source_text: 刨花儿里掉落了一把年轻女人的梳子。

en.t: A young woman's comb had fallen among the wood shavings.
They have come again, haven't they?
That was the tone of the carpenters' words.

units.source_text: 他们似乎觉得有点可厌，却并不稀奇。

en.t: They seemed to find it somewhat distasteful, but not especially unusual.

units.source_text: 因此，那个时候我才觉得这种幽会确有其事似的。

en.t: Because of that, only then did I feel that such secret meetings really did take place.

units.source_text: 不过，我没有进一步去探究这桩似乎是真实的事，

en.t: Still, I did not look any further into this matter that seemed to be true,

units.source_text: 充其量只不过想起“在热恋中的人来说，到处都有空房子嘛”这种奇妙的话语罢了。

en.t: and at most I merely remembered that strange saying: for people deeply in love, there are empty houses everywhere.
